title: Fist of the North Star
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After a nuclear war turns the world to desert, Kenshiro, heir to the lethal martial art Hokuto Shinken, wanders the wasteland defending the weak from gangs and warlords, with the children Bat and Lin. His path leads through rivals who studied beside him, above all his elder brother-in-training Raoh, the conqueror 'Ken-oh'. A later arc follows Lin's abduction to the Kingdom of Shura and ends with Kenshiro training Raoh's son.
life_message: It holds up the strong man who uses his strength, and his sorrow, to protect the defenseless.

folkways.japan: Martial lineage, master-disciple bonds and stoic endurance (gaman) reflect Japanese martial-arts tradition in a post-apocalyptic setting.
